Last week, Republicans passed a budget resolution directing $140 BILLION towards ICE + Border Patrol.

Meanwhile, Democrats offered amendment after amendment to lower the costs of living. Republicans objected to Every. Single. One.

Instead of working to lower the cost of the gas you put in your car, they want to fund a rogue police force that kills citizens in their cars.

THIS WEEK: Senate Democrats will force a SIXTH vote on our War Powers Resolution ending Trump’s war of choice in Iran. 
 
As we reach 60 days of a reckless and unpopular war, will Republicans continue to back Trump and dig themselves deeper into this hole?

Democrats UNANIMOUSLY supported funding the vast majority of DHS, including Secret Service. We passed it in the Senate, not once but twice.
 
It is House Republicans, not Democrats, who are blocking this funding.

I am relieved that no one was seriously injured over the weekend. Political violence has no place in our democracy.
 
I commend law enforcement's swift response to apprehend the gunman which saved many lives, and that includes the Secret Service.
 
House Republicans can and should pass the Senate’s bipartisan bill to fund Secret Service today.

Don’t buy this narrative. The Senate has already passed a unanimous bill to fund all of DHS except ICE.

Mike Johnson blocked it. He could pass it today if he wanted.


Senator Cynthia Lummis (@SenLummis)

Enough is enough. Democrats need to come to their senses & join us in voting to fund DHS.

The Secret Service, who Democrats have refused to fund for months, bravely stopped an attack on our government leaders this weekend. It's time to do the responsible thing and fund @DHSgov.

Another attack on New York offshore wind by Trump.

These projects would have delivered desperately needed cheaper, cleaner energy to our homes and small businesses.

All this does is kill good-paying union jobs and send energy prices even higher. Despicable.

Daily reminder that the Senate passed a BIPARTISAN, UNANIMOUS bill to fund all of DHS except ICE.

Mike Johnson blocked it. He could pass it today if he wanted.


Senator Dave McCormick (@SenMcCormickPA)

A gunman tried to kill @POTUS on Saturday.

The Secret Service agents who stopped him? Working unpaid for 70+ days because Senate Democrats refuse to fund DHS.

To my Democrat colleagues: End the shutdown. Fully fund DHS. Pay the men and women who protect our president.

Today, I stand with the Armenian community to honor the memory of 1.5 million Armenians killed by the Ottoman Turks.

A century later, because of the Azeri campaign of aggression and violence, the Armenian people once again witnessed attack on their fundamental human rights in Nagorno Karabakh.

I will continue calling on the U.S. government to support a true, just, and lasting peace that ensures the release of wrongfully held Armenian prisoners of war by Azerbaijan, as well as recognition and r
I am closely monitoring the unfolding situation at the White House Correspondents Dinner. I’m grateful for the quick response of law enforcement and am praying everyone remains safe.

In the dead of night, Republicans pushed through $140 billion more for ICE while rejecting every single Democratic amendment to lower costs, end the Iran war, and fix our healthcare system. 

They will be held accountable in November.


Headquarters (@HQNewsNow)

Sen. Schumer after Republicans pass $140,000,000,000 for ICE funding instead of affordability measures:

"Republicans showed the American people where they stand. Not for families struggling with the high cost of childcare, groceries, g

Senate Republicans just voted NO on my amendment that said this reconciliation bill should have lowered out-of-pocket health care costs for the American people.

$140 Billion for ICE and Border Patrol.
$0 to lower your health care costs.

Video

🚨 Vote-a-rama starts TONIGHT: While Republicans try to give up to $140 billion to ICE, we’ll be forcing votes all night on lowering costs, ending the war, and making health care cheaper—putting Republicans on the record on the issues Americans care about.


Burgess Everett (@burgessev)

Schumer on the vote-a-rama: “We are going to have lots of amendments”
